From: Raj Patel <rpatel@meridiancg.com>
To: Tom Beck <tbeck@cascadewp.com>
Subject: Harbor Point - Level 4 window flashing

Tom, our super walked Level 4 this morning and the head flashing on the north elevation windows isn't lapped over the WRB the way the shop drawings show. Several units have the membrane terminating behind the flashing. Can your crew get back out there this week before we close up the exterior? We need this fixed before the inspection on the 14th.

From: HR <hr@meridiancg.com>
To: All Staff
Subject: Open enrollment closes Friday

Reminder that benefits open enrollment closes this Friday at 5pm. Log into Workday to review your medical, dental, and vision elections. Contact HR with any questions.

From: Maria Gonzalez <mgonzalez@meridiancg.com>
To: Raj Patel
Subject: RE: Harbor Point unit 512 water intrusion

Raj, the HOA property manager sent photos of staining below the living room window in 512 and says the carpet was wet after Tuesday's storm. This is the third unit on that elevation. I think we need to get Cascade out to do a water test on the window assemblies rather than just resealing again.

From: Raj Patel
To: Project Team
Subject: Lunch Thursday

Team lunch Thursday at 12:30 at the taco place on 3rd to celebrate closing out the Riverside job. Let me know if you have dietary restrictions.

CHANGE ORDER #17
Project: Harbor Point Condominium
Contractor: Meridian Construction Group
Subcontractor: Cascade Waterproofing

Description: Substitute Sikaflex-1a sealant for specified Dow 795 at all window perimeter joints, Levels 2-8. Owner-approved substitution per RFI 041.
Cost impact: ($4,200) credit
Schedule impact: None

From: IT Helpdesk
To: Raj Patel
Subject: Ticket #88213 - VPN issues resolved

Hi Raj, we've pushed a fix for the VPN client disconnect issue. Please restart your laptop and let us know if the problem recurs.

From: Dana Whitcomb <dwhitcomb@meridiancg.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez; Raj Patel
Subject: PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL - Harbor Point leaks - legal advice

Maria, Raj - following our call, my legal advice is that we should not commit in writing to the HOA that the window installation was defective. Please route all further communications with the HOA about the leaks through me. I'm also engaging Whitfield & Barr to evaluate our tender to Cascade's carrier. Please preserve all Harbor Point project files.

From: Accounting
To: Raj Patel
Subject: Expense report September

Raj, your September expense report is missing receipts for two hotel nights on the Bellevue project trip. Please upload them in Concur by end of week.

FIELD REPORT - Harbor Point
Date: 2023-03-22
Inspector: J. Okafor, Meridian QA

Observed: Sealant joints at Level 6 east windows show adhesive failure at the frame interface. Membrane lap at sill not shingled. Weep holes on 3 of 8 units observed were blocked with sealant. Recommend Cascade remove and replace sealant at all Level 6 east openings and clear weeps.

From: Maria Gonzalez
To: Raj Patel
Subject: Riverside Apartments - punch list

Raj, attached is the final punch list for Riverside. Mostly paint touch-ups and a couple of door closers. The owner wants to walk it Monday.

From: Office Manager
To: All Staff
Subject: Water cooler

The water cooler on the 2nd floor is leaking again. Facilities has been called. Please use the kitchen on 3 in the meantime.

From: Tom Beck <tbeck@cascadewp.com>
To: Raj Patel
Subject: RE: Harbor Point - Level 4 window flashing

Raj, we'll have a crew there Wednesday. For the record, the flashing sequence we used matched the mockup that Meridian approved in October. If the WRB was installed after our flashing by your framing sub, that's not on us. Happy to fix it but we'll need a change order.

From: Raj Patel
To: Maria Gonzalez
Subject: Harbor Point - parking for the topping-out party

Maria, the HOA is letting us use the visitor lot for the topping-out event next Friday. Can you order the catering? Around 60 people.

From: Harbor Point HOA <manager@harborpointhoa.org>
To: Maria Gonzalez
Subject: Notice of water damage - Units 312, 412, 512, 612

Ms. Gonzalez, this is formal notice that the Association has documented water intrusion in the units listed above, all on the north elevation, following each significant rain event since January. Our consultant believes the window installation and flashing are the source. We request that Meridian investigate and repair at its cost.

From: Marketing
To: All Staff
Subject: New website launch

Our redesigned website goes live Monday. Please review your bio and headshot on the staging site and send corrections to marketing by Thursday.

From: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@whitfieldbarr.com>
To: Dana Whitcomb
CC: Maria Gonzalez
Subject: Harbor Point - preliminary assessment (ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT)

Dana, our preliminary view based on the field reports and the Cascade correspondence is that Meridian has a strong indemnity claim against Cascade under Section 11 of the subcontract, but the WRB sequencing issue creates some exposure for Meridian directly. I recommend we retain a building envelope expert before responding to the HOA's notice. Draft response attached for your review.

From: Raj Patel
To: Tom Beck
Subject: Golf Saturday?

Tom, a few of us are playing at Willow Creek Saturday at 8. Want to join? Bring your brother if he's in town.

MERIDIAN CONSTRUCTION GROUP
Subcontract Agreement - Exhibit A: Scope of Work
Project: Harbor Point Condominium
Subcontractor: Cascade Waterproofing, Inc.

1. Furnish and install fluid-applied air/water-resistive barrier at all exterior walls.
2. Furnish and install self-adhered flashing membrane at all window and door rough openings, integrated with WRB.
3. Furnish and install perimeter sealant at all exterior window and door frames.
4. Furnish and install below-grade waterproofing membrane at foundation walls.
5. Coordinate sequencing with window installer and framing subcontractor.

From: Maria Gonzalez
To: Project Team
Subject: Confidential - do not forward

Team, there has been a leak of our Bellevue bid numbers to a competitor. Please do not discuss bid pricing outside the company. Anyone with information about how the numbers got out should contact me directly.

From: Raj Patel
To: Cascade Waterproofing (Tom Beck)
Subject: Harbor Point - inspection results and back-charge

Tom, the third-party envelope consultant's water test confirmed leakage at 6 of 8 tested windows through the sill flashing. Per the subcontract, Meridian intends to back-charge Cascade for the remediation. Cost estimate attached. Please have your insurer contact us.

From: Raj Patel
To: Maria Gonzalez
Subject: Harbor Point - elevator inspection certificate

Maria, the state elevator inspection certificate for Harbor Point came through. Both cars passed. I'll forward the certificate to the HOA for their records.

From: Maria Gonzalez
To: Raj Patel
Subject: Harbor Point schedule - exterior closeout

Raj, we're 3 weeks behind on exterior closeout because Cascade is waiting on the flashing re-work at Levels 4 and 6 before they can do the final sealant pass. If we don't recover we lose the window for the stucco sub. Can you push Tom for a firm date?

From: Dana Whitcomb
To: Maria Gonzalez
Subject: PRIVILEGED - Bellevue bid leak - legal advice

Maria, regarding the Bellevue bid information that reached a competitor: my advice is that we should not accuse any employee without documentation. Please send me the access logs and I'll advise on whether we have a trade secret claim. Keep this between us for now.

RFI 041
Project: Harbor Point Condominium
From: Meridian Construction Group
To: Architect of Record

Question: Specification 07 92 00 calls for Dow 795 silicone at window perimeter joints. Cascade Waterproofing proposes Sikaflex-1a polyurethane for compatibility with the self-adhered flashing membrane. Please confirm acceptable.

Architect response: Acceptable provided manufacturer compatibility letter is submitted.

From: Raj Patel
To: Maria Gonzalez
Subject: Harbor Point - lobby finishes

Maria, the HOA board picked the darker quartz for the lobby reception desk. The tile sub can have it templated next week. No cost change.

From: J. Okafor
To: Raj Patel
Subject: Harbor Point - mold in unit 412

Raj, the industrial hygienist's report for 412 came back. Elevated Stachybotrys in the wall cavity below the north window. They're recommending containment and removal of drywall and insulation across about 40 sq ft. The moisture source is consistent with the window sill leak.

From: Safety Director
To: All Field Staff
Subject: Heat illness prevention

With temperatures forecast above 95 this week, remember mandatory shade breaks every hour and hydration stations on every floor. Report any symptoms to your foreman immediately.

From: Maria Gonzalez
To: Raj Patel
Subject: FW: PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL - Harbor Point leaks - legal advice

Raj, see Dana's note below. Per her instructions, stop responding to the HOA directly about the leaks and send anything you get to Dana. She also wants the Cascade file pulled together by Friday.

[forwarded message from Dana Whitcomb containing legal advice regarding communications with the HOA and the tender to Cascade's carrier]

From: Raj Patel
To: Tom Beck
Subject: Bellevue Tower - waterproofing bid

Tom, can Cascade put together a number for the below-grade waterproofing and plaza deck on Bellevue Tower? Drawings in the shared folder. Bid due to owner in three weeks.

From: Raj Patel
To: Maria Gonzalez
Subject: Harbor Point - repair cost estimate

Maria, rough order of magnitude for full remediation of the north elevation: remove and reinstall windows on 4 levels, new flashing and sealant, interior drywall repairs in 4 units, mold remediation in 412. About $610k including the envelope consultant. Cascade's share should be most of it.

From: Maria Gonzalez
To: Raj Patel
Subject: Envelope for the HOA

Raj, I left the envelope with the signed warranty binders for the HOA on your desk. Can you drop it at the property manager's office when you're on site?

Meeting Minutes - Harbor Point OAC Meeting #34
Attendees: Meridian (Gonzalez, Patel), Architect, HOA Board Rep

Item 4: Water intrusion. HOA reports continued leaks at north elevation units after recent rain. Meridian to coordinate water testing with Cascade Waterproofing and envelope consultant. Architect notes flashing detail 5/A-501 requires membrane to lap over head flashing; field conditions to be verified. Action: Meridian, by 4/15.

From: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@whitfieldbarr.com>
To: Dana Whitcomb
Subject: Riverside Apartments lien - legal advice

Dana, on the Riverside mechanic's lien filed by the drywall sub: the lien was recorded outside the 90-day window under the statute and is likely invalid. I recommend we send a demand to release. Draft attached. This communication is privileged and confidential.

From: Tom Beck <tbeck@cascadewp.com>
To: Raj Patel
Subject: RE: Harbor Point - inspection results and back-charge

Raj, we dispute the back-charge. Our sealant and flashing were installed per the approved mockup and inspected by your QA. The consultant's test doesn't isolate whether water entered through our work or through the window units themselves, which were supplied by a different sub. We've notified our carrier as a courtesy but deny responsibility.

From: Raj Patel
To: Maria Gonzalez
Subject: PTO next week

Maria, reminder I'm out Wednesday through Friday next week. Jamal will cover Harbor Point site walks.

From: Maria Gonzalez
To: Harbor Point HOA <manager@harborpointhoa.org>
Subject: RE: Notice of water damage - Units 312, 412, 512, 612

We have received your notice and are investigating with our subcontractor. Meridian will schedule water testing at the affected units and will share the results. Please coordinate access for the units with Raj Patel.
